results.name: Tabletop Pool Table
results.description: This highly detailed 3D miniature is a perfect 1:12 scale recreation of a professional billiard table, measuring exactly 6 x 4 inches. The frame is crafted from a polished dark walnut wood, featuring miniature pockets. The playing surface is upholstered in a traditional forest green felt with a fine-fiber texture. Accompanying the table is a complete set of glossy resin pool balls, each precisely painted with numbers and stripes, along with a matching triangular wooden rack.  This asset is ideal for dollhouse dioramas, game room vignettes, or as a desk-toy prop in a modern office render.
